name: stack-audit
description: Engineering standards and read-only audits for React/Next.js apps, Postgres/Drizzle databases, Docker/Compose stacks, and OWASP-backed security and ASVS self-assessment.

interface.shortDescription: Standards and read-only audits for Next.js, Postgres, Docker and OWASP
interface.longDescription: Four skills with citable rules and read-only audit scripts: web-standards (React/Next.js), data-standards (Postgres/Drizzle schemas, migrations and server hardening), container-standards (Dockerfiles, Compose, Docker hosts, optional Coolify live checks) and owasp-security (OWASP cheat sheets and ASVS 5.0). Findings cite rule IDs with file:line and a fix.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo before launch: security, accessibility and the Docker setup.
Is this migration safe to run on production?
What does OWASP recommend for password reset flows? Cite the cheat sheet section.
